summary: The precinct chair calls for the wording of a lost credential so the election can go ahead.
realLife: J. B. Harrington recalled that the chair in his Jackson precinct phoned Mrs. Ware and brought replacement copies after the printed forms went missing.
gates: The printed credentials are missing before a precinct election.
inGame: needs: a missing credential form and the precinct contact who can confirm its wording.

turns.what: The secretary transfers the result to it.
turns.pulledBy: A blank turns up before the delegates leave.
turns.writesBack: The county receives the usual form.

turns.what: The chair asks the county clerk to certify the return later.
turns.pulledBy: Nobody can confirm the wording that morning.
turns.writesBack: The delegate leaves with certification pending.
